candidates.reason: The cans are broken up: one large can floats top-centre and two tiny ones sit mid-canvas. The flavour names are stacked in a right column with no cans next to them. 'Warm & herbal' and 'Cool & crisp' are cut off from their flavours and dumped below the CTA, and Honey Rosemary and Cucumber Mint are swapped against their descriptors. The CTA pill is tiny next to the huge headline, the right column is cramped while the left half is mostly headline, and the reading order is jumbled.

Worse scattering than candidate 1. Honey Rosemary sits above the body copy like a subhead. Blood Orange and Cucumber Mint are pushed into the bottom-centre under two tiny cans, and Cucumber Mint has lost its descriptor. 'Warm & herbal' and 'Cool & crisp' float under the delivery note with no flavour attached, and the hero can stands alone at the top right. There is no grid, the three-flavour story is unreadable as a set, and it is cramped at the bottom while the top right is empty.

The headline and the three flavour names are crammed into one stack at nearly the same size, so the hierarchy is lost. The flavour order is reversed, and the descriptors are listed separately, out of order and unpaired. The CTA is oversized and gets as much weight as the headline. The logo and two tiny cans are stranded at the bottom with a large empty band above them, and the single big can on the left is cut off from its flavour.

Keeps the original structure: logo, then headline, then three cans with paired name and descriptor in order, then copy, CTA and delivery note, all well aligned on the centre axis. Flaws: the logo is noticeably smaller than in the original, and on the square canvas there are wide empty side margins and a dead band about 100 px tall at the bottom, so it reads as the original placed onto a larger canvas rather than recomposed. Spacing is fine but needs a vertical rebalance.
